gym_address: 2nd Floor, City Mall, Sector 18, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301
instructions:
Check-in: on arrival, check in at the front desk if required.
Attire and hygiene: wear workout attire and clean, non-marking athletic shoes. Bring a towel to wipe down equipment after use.
Warm-up: start with a 5-10 minute warm-up, such as light cardio or dynamic stretching.
Equipment: if you are new, familiarise yourself with the machines and ask the staff for guidance.
Cardio equipment: adjust the machines to your fitness level and wipe them down before and after use.
Hydration: drink water before, during and after your workout.
Rest periods: rest between sets, but avoid hogging equipment during peak hours.
Cool down: finish with 5-10 minutes of light stretching.
Personal belongings: keep your belongings in the lockers provided and never leave valuables unattended.
Enjoy and stay consistent: consistency is key to reaching your fitness goals.
